purpose: Lets prospects pick a demo or counselling slot within business hours, either via an embedded Calendly/Google appointment page or a built-in slot request form.

outputSchema.description: Booking request event sent to schedule-appointment

configurationFields.description: Required for Calendly Link / Google appointment page embeds

permissionsRequired: Read free/busy on the client's booking calendar (via schedule-appointment)

testCases.description: Request a slot inside business hours
testCases.expectedOutcome: Request accepted and forwarded to schedule-appointment

testCases.description: Request a slot outside business hours or in the past

testCases.expectedOutcome: Embed loads; no API calls made from the site

knownLimitations: Contract only: Angular implementation not yet built (Phase B).
Built-in mode creates requests, not confirmed bookings; staff confirm in the calendar.
rollbackApproach: Switch booking.type to 'Manual Follow-up Only' in site.config.json and redeploy.
